# clavis promote

<p class="cli-lead">Promote selected keys between environments</p>

<div class="cli-usage">

```sh
clavis promote [flags]
```

</div>

Copy values from one environment to another, safely: Clavis shows the
differences, you pick keys, the schema is checked, the target is
snapshotted, then the values are copied. Statuses are `added`, `changed`,
`missing` (only in the target) and `unchanged`.

## Examples

```sh
clavis promote --from dev --to staging
```

<p class="cli-example-title">Only some keys</p>

```sh
clavis promote --from dev --to staging --keys DATABASE_URL,STRIPE_KEY
```

<p class="cli-example-title">Pick keys interactively</p>

```sh
clavis promote --from staging --to production --interactive
```

<p class="cli-example-title">Ask an admin to approve</p>

```sh
clavis promote --from staging --to production --request
```

## Flags

<dl class="cli-flags">
<div class="cli-flag" id="flag-all"><dt><code>--all</code></dt><dd>promote every added and changed key</dd></div>
<div class="cli-flag" id="flag-from"><dt><code>--from string</code></dt><dd>source environment (default: linked env)</dd></div>
<div class="cli-flag" id="flag-interactive"><dt><code>-i, --interactive</code></dt><dd>choose keys interactively</dd></div>
<div class="cli-flag" id="flag-keys"><dt><code>--keys string</code></dt><dd>comma-separated keys to promote</dd></div>
<div class="cli-flag" id="flag-message"><dt><code>--message string</code></dt><dd>change message recorded in history</dd></div>
<div class="cli-flag" id="flag-request"><dt><code>--request</code></dt><dd>create an approval request instead of writing</dd></div>
<div class="cli-flag" id="flag-snapshot"><dt><code>--snapshot</code></dt><dd>snapshot the target before writing <span class="cli-default">Default: <code>true</code></span></dd></div>
<div class="cli-flag" id="flag-to"><dt><code>--to string</code></dt><dd>target environment</dd></div>
<div class="cli-flag" id="flag-yes"><dt><code>--yes</code></dt><dd>skip production confirmation</dd></div>
</dl>

## Details

- New and changed keys are selected by default.
- Schema errors block the promotion.
- Protected targets need an Admin or Owner; others pass `--request` and
  an admin approves it on the **Promote** page.
